#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;

typedef long long ll;

struct PairII {
    int a, b;
    PairII(int a, int b) : a(a), b(b) {}
};

struct sortCond {
    bool operator()(const PairII& p1, const PairII& p2) {
        return p1.a <= p2.a;
    }
};

struct Rec {
    int a, b;
    ll c;
    Rec(int a, int b, ll c) : a(a), b(b), c(c) {}
};

// mod operations interface
int modAdd(int a, int b, int mod);
int modSub(int a, int b, int mod);
int modMul(int a, int b, int mod);
int modDiv(int a, int b, int mod);

int findBinaryExponentian(int a, int pow, int mod) {
    if (pow == 1) return a;
    if (pow == 0) return 1;
    int retVal = findBinaryExponentian(a, (int)pow / 2, mod);
    int val = (pow % 2 == 0) ? 1 : a;
    return modMul(modMul(retVal, retVal, mod), val, mod);
}

int findPow(int a, int b, int mod) {
    if (b == 1) return a % mod;
    if (b == 0) return 1;
    int res = findPow(a, (int)b / 2, mod);
    return modMul(res, modMul(res, (b % 2 == 1 ? a : 1), mod), mod);
}

int bleft(int ele, vector<int>& sortedArr) {
    int l = 0, h = sortedArr.size() - 1, ans = -1;
    while (l <= h) {
        int mid = l + (h - l) / 2;
        if (sortedArr[mid] < ele) {
            ans = mid;
            l = mid + 1;
        } else if (sortedArr[mid] >= ele) {
            h = mid - 1;
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

int gcd(int a, int b) {
    int div = b, rem = a % b;
    while (rem != 0) {
        int temp = rem;
        rem = div % rem;
        div = temp;
    }
    return div;
}

vector<ll> logFunc(ll no, ll n) {
    ll i = 1;
    int cnt = 0;
    ll sum = 0;
    vector<ll> arr(2, 0);
    while (i < no) {
        sum += i;
        cnt++;
        if (sum == n) {
            arr[0] = cnt;
            arr[1] = sum;
            break;
        }
        i *= 2;
    }
    if (arr[0] == 0) {
        arr[0] = cnt;
        arr[1] = sum;
    }
    return arr;
}

int modAdd(int a, int b, int mod) {
    return (a % mod + b % mod) % mod;
}
int modSub(int a, int b, int mod) {
    return (int)((1LL * a % mod - 1LL * b % mod + 1LL * mod) % mod);
}
int modMul(int a, int b, int mod) {
    return (int)((1LL * (a % mod) * 1LL * (b % mod)) % (1LL * mod));
}
int modDiv(int a, int b, int mod) {
    return modMul(a, findBinaryExponentian(b, mod - 1, mod), mod);
}

unordered_set<int> primeList(int MAXI) {
    vector<int> prime(MAXI + 1, 0);
    unordered_set<int> obj;
    for (int i = 2; i <= (int)sqrt(MAXI) + 1; i++) {
        if (prime[i] == 0) {
            obj.insert(i);
            for (int j = i * i; j <= MAXI; j += i) {
                prime[j] = 1;
            }
        }
    }
    for (int i = (int)sqrt(MAXI) + 1; i <= MAXI; i++) {
        if (prime[i] == 0) obj.insert(i);
    }
    return obj;
}

vector<int> factorialList(int MAXI, int mod) {
    vector<int> factorial(MAXI + 1);
    factorial[2] = 1;
    for (int i = 3; i < MAXI + 1; i++) {
        factorial[i] = modMul(factorial[i - 1], i, mod);
    }
    return factorial;
}

void put(unordered_map<int, int>& cnt, int key) {
    if (cnt.count(key)) {
        cnt[key]++;
    } else {
        cnt[key] = 1;
    }
}

ll arrSum(vector<ll>& arr) {
    ll tot = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < arr.size(); i++) tot += arr[i];
    return tot;
}

int ord(char b) {
    return (int)b - (int)'a';
}

int optimSearch(vector<int>& cnt, int lower_bound, int pow, int n) {
    int l = lower_bound + 1, h = n, ans = 0;
    while (l <= h) {
        int mid = l + (h - l) / 2;
        if (cnt[mid] - cnt[lower_bound] == pow) return mid;
        else if (cnt[mid] - cnt[lower_bound] < pow) {
            ans = mid;
            l = mid + 1;
        } else {
            h = mid - 1;
        }
    }
    return ans;
}

PairII ret_ans(vector<int>& ans) {
    int size = ans.size();
    int mini = 1000000000 + 1;
    ll tit = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
        tit += ans[i];
        mini = min(mini, ans[i]);
    }
    return PairII(tit - mini, mini);
}

int factorList(unordered_map<int, int>& maps, int no, int maxK, int req) {
    int i = 1;
    while (i * i <= no) {
        if (no % i == 0) {
            if (i != no / i) put(maps, no / i);
            put(maps, i);
            if (maps[i] == req) maxK = max(maxK, i);
            if (maps[no / i] == req) maxK = max(maxK, no / i);
        }
        i++;
    }
    return maxK;
}

vector<int> getKeys(unordered_map<int, int>& maps) {
    vector<int> vals;
    for (auto& p : maps) vals.push_back(p.first);
    return vals;
}

vector<int> getValues(unordered_map<int, int>& maps) {
    vector<int> vals;
    for (auto& p : maps) vals.push_back(p.second);
    return vals;
}

int getMax(vector<int>& arr) {
    int mx = arr[0];
    for (int i = 1; i < arr.size(); i++) if (arr[i] > mx) mx = arr[i];
    return mx;
}

int getMin(vector<int>& arr) {
    int mn = arr[0];
    for (int i = 1; i < arr.size(); i++) if (arr[i] < mn) mn = arr[i];
    return mn;
}

        int ways = 0;
        string v = s.substr(n - 2, 2);
        for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) {
            if (v == digits[i]) ways = 1;
        }
        if (v[0] == '_' || v[0] == 'X') {
            ways = 2;
            if (v[1] == '0' && s[0] == 'X') ways = 1;
        } else if (v[1] == '_' || v[1] == 'X') {

        }
        for (i = 0; i < 4; i++) {

        }

        if (v[0] != '2' && v[0] != '5' && v[0] != '7' && v[0] != '0' && v[0] != 'X' && v[0] != '_') ways = 0;
        if (v[1] != '0' && v[1] != '5' && v[1] != 'X' && v[1] != '_') ways = 0;
        bool ok = false;
        ll toti = 1;
        for (i = 0; i < n - 2; i++) {

    }

}
